title: Training Note on ProBuild Perk Redemption
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards points are redeemed for perk rewards only in whole blocks, only from available points, only while the membership is active, and within a yearly ceiling on the value of perk rewards issued.

## The rule

Points are redeemed only in whole blocks of the tier's redemption block size, each issuing a perk reward worth the tier's perk reward value, usable for the tier's perk validity, in days, after issue. Points may be redeemed only while the membership status is active. Only available points can be redeemed, and the value of perk rewards issued in the program year, those already issued in that year plus this redemption, may not exceed the tier's yearly perk ceiling. A perk reward may not be used on a purchase priced under a volume pricing quote where the tier does not allow perk rewards on such purchases, and an expired perk reward is not reissued.

## Questions answered

**What are available points?**
The points balance of the membership less the points whose available date is after the current date. Points whose available date is the current date or earlier are available.

**How many blocks can a member redeem? (hypothetical figures)**
With 6100 available points and a block size of 2500, at most two blocks: 5000 points for two perk rewards worth USD 25.00 each, USD 50.00 in all. The remaining 1100 points do not make a whole block and are not redeemed.

**How does the yearly ceiling limit a redemption? (hypothetical figures)**
With a yearly ceiling of USD 500.00, perk rewards worth USD 450.00 already issued in the program year and a perk reward value of USD 25.00, this redemption may issue at most USD 50.00, that is two perk rewards, whatever the available points.

**Can a member whose balance is below zero redeem?**
A balance below zero leaves no available points, so no whole block can be redeemed.

**Can points be redeemed on a suspended, pending or closed membership?**
No. Points may be redeemed only while the membership status is active.

**Can a perk reward be used on a quote-priced purchase?**
Not where the tier does not allow perk rewards on purchases priced under a volume pricing quote.

**Can an expired perk reward be issued again?**
No. An expired perk reward is not reissued.
